description.summary: live semantic tree for a toplevel (COMP-09)

protocol.description:
A client publishes a live semantic tree (P-01) for one of its own toplevels. The compositor stores the authoritative copy and serves it to agents; an agent query never reaches the client. Everything the client says is data: rectangles are clamped, sensitivity can only be raised and password values are discarded.
Published on the public socket. A client can describe only its own surfaces, which object ownership enforces. Node ids are chosen by the client, are nonzero and are scoped to one eclipse_semantic_surface_v1. Changes are applied to the compositor's model as they arrive but are invisible to agents until commit.

interface.name: eclipse_semantic_manager_v1
interface.description: The global. The compositor announces its capabilities on bind.

enum.name: error
enum.description: Codes are shared with eclipse_semantic_surface_v1.error so a client sees one numbering (COMP-09 section 2).

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a semantic surface

entry.name: not_owner
entry.summary: the toplevel belongs to another client

request.name: get_semantic_surface

description.summary: attach a semantic tree to a toplevel

request.description: One per toplevel; a second call while the first object lives is protocol error already_exists.

interface.name: eclipse_semantic_surface_v1

description.summary: the semantic tree of one toplevel

interface.description: Requests edit a pending model; commit applies it atomically. A commit that changes structure, rectangles, roles, states, actions or sensitivity bumps the tree generation; one that changes only names, descriptions, values or extensions bumps the value revision.

entry.name: invalid_node
entry.summary: unknown or zero node id, or commit with no root

entry.name: invalid_parent
entry.summary: parent missing, root moved, or tree too deep

entry.name: cycle
entry.summary: move_node would make a node its own ancestor

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: node id in use, or a root already set

entry.name: lower_classification
entry.summary: attempt to lower sensitivity, ext.irreversible or ext.credential (the wire code of v0.1 LOWER_SENSITIVITY)

entry.name: ext_limit
entry.summary: ext key count or size, or the model node limit, exceeded

description.summary: P-01 section 1.4 verbs; 256 and above are custom, named by set_action_label

entry.name: client_timeout
entry.summary: compositor-reported only; a client ack of 4 or more counts as failed

request.name: set_root
request.description: Creates the root with this id. A root already set is already_exists; remove_node the root first to replace it.

description.summary: create a node under a parent

arg.name: index
arg.summary: position among the parent's children; past the end appends

description.summary: remove a node and its subtree

request.name: set_rect

description.summary: surface-local logical rectangle, including CSD offsets

request.description: Clamped to the surface at commit; a clamped node carries ext.clamped.

description.summary: the full state set, replacing the old one
text value; discarded for password nodes
the full verb set, replacing the old one
label (or custom verb name) for a verb the node offers

request.name: set_sensitivity
request.description: The default is private. Declaring a lower class than the node already has is protocol error lower_classification. The compositor may hold a higher class than declared and says nothing about it.

arg.name: class
arg.summary: class enum; an unknown value counts as secret

request.name: set_ext
request.description: At most 16 keys per node, keys up to 64 bytes, values up to 256. Reserved keys: irreversible (a taxonomy id) and credential (a bool) are raise-only, like set_sensitivity; clamped is set by the compositor and ignored here.

request.name: commit
request.description: Nothing is visible to agents until commit.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying with uncommitted changes is protocol error uncommitted_destroy. The compositor keeps the last committed tree for one second so an agent's in-flight query answers client_gone.

event.name: action_requested

description.summary: perform an action for an agent

event.description: Already policy-checked. The client must ack within 2 s or the compositor reports client_timeout to the agent.

description.summary: the node an agent seat is targeting for text commit

event.name: budget_exceeded

description.summary: the tree was truncated, or an extension was dropped

event.description: The client should prune, for example by virtualising offscreen lists. Also sent when an ext.irreversible id is not in the compiled taxonomy and was dropped.
